text.p: Poland ended a run of 13 internationals without a win by overcoming Moldova 2-1 in a World Cup qualifier on Sunday.
They took a fourth-minute lead from a free-kick by Henryk Baluszynski and clinched the points through Krzysztof Warzycha's second-half penalty.
Moldova replied in the 78th minute when Serghei Clescenco converted a spot kick.
Baluszynski's free-kick taken from five metres outside the penalty area curved around the Moldovan defensive wall and took goalkeeper Denis Romanenco by surprise.
Poland doubled their tally after Cezary Kucharski was fouled in the penalty area.
The win left them three points behind Italy and six adrift of England in group two.
